summary: Executed iteration48 frontend-heavy verification with backend read-only checks. Isolated frontend regressions and new iteration48 tests passed; hosted UI loaded for 390/320 with original artworks; read-only backend direct canonical path was intermittently unavailable (timeouts), and web proxy auth session endpoint showed transient 503 causing login spinner in one run.

Transient 503 observed in browser console during rapid smoke run; UI stayed on spinner/login-unavailable state in that run.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent infinite loading/spinner state seen in web preview when session bootstrap call fails (503).

integration_issues.issue: Could not reliably progress to RAPID tab in failed session-bootstrap run due auth/session 503 + spinner.

action_items: Investigate canonical transport reliability for direct jeelive.ai auth from this environment (timeouts), then rerun direct-vs-proxy image SHA parity tests.
Investigate intermittent /api/jl/auth/session 503 and add robust UI recovery path so app does not remain on spinner/login-blocked state.
After session bootstrap stabilization, re-run RAPID read-only smoke and remaining UI checks (solution grid/zoom, retry paths) in one authenticated session.

Queue fanout benchmark against commit 63241ad shows mechanical callback reduction under 75 synthetic completions (old_global=16 vs current_path=2 in isolated harness).

OfflineMath shell remains stable-source and in-RAM update driven; external navigation remains blocked via about:blank/data-only gate. Native WebView runtime performance itself is not measurable in this web-only environment.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use same approved live PIN credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Keep read-only scope. First verify /api/jl/auth/session stability, then re-run direct-vs-proxy image SHA parity and rapid tab smoke in one login session.
rca_of_issue: RCA: failure mode is upstream/session bootstrap reliability, not local selector/test script. Evidence: browser console captured 503 on /api/jl/auth/session and screenshot showed login unavailable state; separate run with same build/credentials successfully logged in and rendered 4 artworks + performance screen. Direct canonical timeout similarly indicates transport/upstream availability issue from this runtime. Mitigation: strengthen retry/backoff/fallback UX for session bootstrap and revalidate once upstream stabilizes.
